items.headline: 学习预报误差，改善未来数周预测
items.headline_en: Learning forecast errors improves the weeks ahead
items.summary: 10月14日发表的研究用机器学习从历史预报误差中学习，校正未来两至六周的概率预报。方法在2025年实时竞赛中表现领先，也改善了极端天气概率的预测。这有望帮助农业、能源与防灾提前规划，但不意味着能准确报出六周后每天的天气。
items.summary_en: A study published on October 14 used machine learning to learn from past forecast errors and improve probabilistic predictions two to six weeks ahead. The method led a 2025 real-time forecasting competition and improved predictions of extreme weather. It could support farming, energy and disaster planning; it does not make daily weather six weeks away certain.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 经济学奖关注家庭与企业的选择
items.summary: 10月12日，2026年诺贝尔经济学奖宣布授予罗伯特·E·霍尔与迈克尔·伍德福德。他们把家庭消费、储蓄和企业定价等决策纳入宏观模型，说明预期如何影响今天的经济。这些模型帮助政府和央行评估稳定经济的政策，也随现实变化继续完善。
items.summary_en: On October 12, the 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences was awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford. Their work connects household spending and saving, and business pricing, to the wider economy, showing how expectations shape decisions today. These models help policymakers assess stabilisation policies and continue to evolve as economies change.

source.name: 瑞典皇家科学院 / Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences

items.headline: 柔软薄片用光追踪自身形状
items.headline_en: A soft sheet uses light to sense its own shape
items.summary: MIT10月8日报道，一种柔软薄片把软光纤嵌入硅胶；弯曲改变透过的光量，算法据此重建三维形状。实验中，少量光纤受损后仍能重建整体形状。它为动作追踪提供新思路；康复监测等应用仍属研究设想。
items.summary_en: MIT reported on October 8 that soft optical fibres embedded in silicone let a flexible sheet reconstruct its three-dimensional shape. Bending changes the transmitted light, which an algorithm translates into shape. Experiments retained overall sensing after some fibres were damaged. The prototype suggests a new route to motion tracking; uses such as rehabilitation monitoring remain proposed applications.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 太阳风的混乱中发现新规律
items.headline_en: Hidden order found in the solar wind
items.summary: 10月13日公布的研究利用帕克太阳探测器数据，发现太阳风磁场波动的旋转方向，会在从大尺度流体行为过渡到小尺度粒子行为时反转。这为理解太空等离子体湍流与空间天气提供线索，尚不是新的磁暴预报工具。
items.summary_en: Research announced on October 13 used Parker Solar Probe data to reveal a reversal in the rotation of magnetic-field fluctuations where solar-wind behaviour changes from fluid-like to particle-dominated scales. The finding offers a clue to turbulence in space plasmas and to space-weather research; it is not yet a new tool for forecasting geomagnetic storms.

source.name: 布伦瑞克工业大学 / TU Braunschweig

items.headline: 星系团碰撞让旧粒子云重新发亮
items.headline_en: A collision may have revived a cosmic particle cloud
items.summary: NASA10月14日报道，X射线与射电观测支持“高音谱号”结构的两步成因：黑洞早期喷发留下的带电粒子云逐渐变暗，随后星系团碰撞使其重新发亮。冲击波可能参与再加能。多波段资料帮助追溯巨型结构的历史；这是对古老事件的解释，并非碰撞刚刚发生。
items.summary_en: NASA reported on October 14 that X-ray and radio observations suggest a two-stage origin for the “Treble Clef” structure. A particle cloud from an earlier black-hole outburst faded, then a galaxy-cluster collision brightened it again. Shock waves may have helped reenergise it. Combining wavelengths helps reconstruct cosmic history; the report explains ancient events, not a collision occurring now.

items.headline: 新型电池“胶水”让回收更容易
items.headline_en: A new battery binder could simplify recycling
items.summary: 10月9日发表的研究提出不含氟、可用水加工的电池黏结剂：柠檬酸连接两种聚合物，稳固电极，也让拆解后的电极涂层在水中与金属箔分离。实验电池保持良好性能，为更清洁的制造与回收提供思路；商业化放大仍待完成。
items.summary_en: A study published on October 9 introduced a fluorine-free, water-processable battery binder. Citric acid links two polymers to hold electrodes together while allowing coatings to separate from metal foils in water after disassembly. Test batteries maintained strong performance, suggesting cleaner manufacturing and recycling; scaling up for commercial production remains a future step.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

previous_answers.headline: 把1至9按顺序写成3×3方格：第一行1、2、3，第二行4、5、6，第三行7、8、9。圈出3个数，每行、每列恰好一个。总和最大能是多少？为什么？
previous_answers.headline_en: Write 1–9 in a 3×3 grid, with rows 1,2,3; 4,5,6; and 7,8,9. Circle three numbers, exactly one in each row and column. What is the largest possible sum? Why?
previous_answers.explanation: 每个数可写成“行贡献”加“列贡献”：三行分别贡献0、3、6，三列分别贡献1、2、3。每行、每列各选一次，总和恒为0＋3＋6＋1＋2＋3＝15，所以最大值也是15。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Each entry is a row contribution plus a column contribution. The rows contribute 0, 3 and 6; the columns contribute 1, 2 and 3. Choosing one entry from every row and column gives 0+3+6+1+2+3=15, whatever the choice. The maximum is therefore 15.

previous_answers.headline: 模拟测试：10000条消息中有100条垃圾信息。筛选器标记了其中90条，又误标其余9900条中的1%。从被标记的消息中等概率抽一条，它真是垃圾信息的概率是多少？
previous_answers.headline_en: A simulated test has 10,000 messages, including 100 spam messages. A filter flags 90 of the spam messages and 1% of the other 9,900 messages. Pick uniformly from the flagged messages. What is the probability it is actually spam?
previous_answers.explanation: 真正被标记的垃圾信息有90条；正常消息中误标了9900×1%＝99条。被标记的共有90＋99＝189条，因此所求概率是90/189＝10/21，约47.6%。抽样范围是全部被标记的消息。
previous_answers.explanation_en: There are 90 correctly flagged spam messages and 9,900×1%=99 falsely flagged non-spam messages. The flagged pool therefore contains 189 messages. The required probability is 90/189=10/21, about 47.6%. The denominator counts all flagged messages.

previous_answers.headline: 在边长10米的正方形内或边界上任放5个传感器。证明：至少两个的直线距离不超过5√2米。能保证不超过7米吗？请说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: Place five sensors anywhere inside or on a square of side 10 m. Prove that some pair is at most 5√2 m apart. Can you always guarantee a pair at most 7 m apart? Justify your answer.
previous_answers.result_en: At most 5√2 m; 7 m is not guaranteed
previous_answers.explanation: 把正方形分成4个边长5米的小正方形，分界线上的点只归入其中一格。5点必有2点同格，距离不超过该格对角线5√2米。四角和中心各放一点，最近距离仍为5√2米，大于7米。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Divide the square into four 5 m squares, assigning each boundary point to just one cell. Two sensors share a cell, so their distance is at most its diagonal, 5√2 m. For sensors at the four corners and centre, the minimum distance is 5√2 m > 7 m.

challenges.headline: 把1至9各用一次，排在一个圆周上。每三个相邻位置的数相加，共得到九个和。这九个和中的最大值，最小能是多少？先试排，再证明你的答案最优。
challenges.headline_en: Arrange 1–9 around a circle, using each number once. Add each group of three consecutive numbers to obtain nine sums. What is the smallest possible value of the largest sum? Experiment, then prove your answer is optimal.

challenges.headline: 两枚公平六面骰子独立掷出，已知点数不同。只看第一枚，决定保留第二枚或独立重掷第二枚一次；决定前不看第二枚，重掷后必须用新点数，可与第一枚相同。最终点数和至少为8算赢。求最优策略与最大胜率。
challenges.headline_en: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled independently; their results are known to differ. Seeing only the first, choose to keep the hidden second die or reroll it once independently. You must accept the new result, even if it equals the first. A final sum of at least 8 wins. Find the optimal strategy and maximum win probability.

challenges.headline: 六个点两两相连，每条连线涂红或蓝。三条边同色的三角形，最少能有几个？请证明下界，并画出达到下界的涂色方案。挑战：能否让红色、蓝色三角形各恰好一个？
challenges.headline_en: Join every pair of six points, colouring each edge red or blue. What is the minimum number of triangles with all three edges the same colour? Prove a lower bound and draw a colouring that attains it. Bonus: can there be exactly one red triangle and one blue triangle?
